description: This PHP class file defines the 'reqMgrSystemCommands' class, which manages system commands for a request management system within the TestLink project. It includes methods for creating, editing, updating, deleting, and checking connections of system entities, along with GUI initialization and configuration handling.

classes.name: reqMgrSystemCommands
classes.description: A class providing command operations for request system management, including CRUD operations and connection checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database handler, system manager, and access control whitelist.

methods.name: setTemplateCfg
methods.description: Sets the template configuration for GUI rendering.

methods.name: getGuiOpWhiteList
methods.description: Returns the whitelist of GUI operations.

methods.name: initGuiBean
methods.description: Initializes GUI data object with action, permissions, labels, and descriptions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares GUI object for creating a new system entity.

methods.description: Handles creation of a new system entity and updates GUI accordingly.

methods.description: Prepares GUI object for editing an existing entity.

methods.description: Handles updating an existing entity and updates GUI accordingly.

methods.description: Deletes an entity and updates GUI.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks the connection status of a system entity.
